# 1 Setup

## 1.1 Reset workspace and set defaults

```{r reset, include=FALSE}
# Clear all plots and variables from workspace
graphics.off()
rm(list=ls(all.names=TRUE))

# Set numerical precision and color schemes
options(digits = 3)
options(ggplot2.discrete.colour= c("#615F63","#FF7F6F","#2F7FC1","#FFBE7A"))
options(ggplot2.discrete.fill= c("#615F63","#FF7F6F","#2F7FC1","#FFBE7A"))
```

## 1.2 Load packages and helper functions

```{r}
# Install and load required packages
if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("pacman")

# CRAN packages for data analysis and visualization
pacman::p_load(
  char = c(
    "tidyverse", "brms", "ggpubr", "tidybayes", "bayestestR",
    "ggh4x", "scales", "insight"
  )
)

# GitHub packages for specialized functions
pacman::p_load_gh(
  char = c(
    "chenyu-psy/smartr@v0.3.2",
    "chenyu-psy/taskr@v0.3.1"
  )
)

# Source helper functions for readable labels, model summaries, plots, and preprocessing
source("./helpers/label_helpers.R")
source("./helpers/model_helpers.R")
source("./helpers/plot_helpers.R")
source("./helpers/preprocess_helpers.R")

# Set default ggplot theme
theme_set(theme_analysis())

# Define the position dodge used in plots
dodge2 <- position_dodge(0.2)

# Define task name and directory paths
task <- "Exp1"
model_path <- str_glue("./results/models/models_{task}/")
figure_path <- str_glue("./results/figures/figures_{task}/")
stats_path <- "./results/stats/"


# Create directories if they do not exist
dir.create(model_path, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figure_path, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(stats_path, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Run one background model-fitting task at a time so long Stan jobs are easy to monitor.
taskr::init_queue(max_slots = 1)

```

# 2 Data preparation

## 2.1 Load raw task and survey data

Condition codes follow the manuscript notation: `A` = None, `B` = R,
`C` = J + R, and `D` = E + J + R.

```{r}

Raw_data <- str_glue("./data/source/Data_{task}.csv") %>%
  read_csv() %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("A", "B", "C", "D")))

Survey_data <- str_glue("./data/source/Survey_{task}.csv") %>%
  read_csv()

```

## 2.2 Apply participant exclusion criteria

### 2.2.1 Self-reported distraction or aid use

```{r}

excluded_self_report <- Survey_data %>%
  filter(str_detect(aid, "Yes") | str_detect(attention, "Yes")) %>%
  pull(participant)

message(str_glue(
  "Excluded {length(excluded_self_report)} participants due to distraction or aid use."
))

```

### 2.2.2 Low response rate or low accuracy

```{r}

excluded_low_performance <- Raw_data %>%
  filter(
    !participant %in% excluded_self_report,
    screenID == "memory-resp",
    condition != "A"
  ) %>%
  filter_low_perf(
    response_col = "response",
    acc_col = "acc",
    min_resp = 0.5,
    min_acc = 0.7,
    .by = "participant"
  ) %>%
  pull(participant)

message(str_glue(
  "Excluded {length(excluded_low_performance)} additional participants due to low response rate or low accuracy."
))

```

### 2.2.3 Participant-exclusion summary

```{r}
excluded_participants <- union(
  excluded_self_report,
  excluded_low_performance
)

Data_Participant_Status <- Raw_data %>%
  distinct(participant) %>%
  mutate(
    excluded_self_report = participant %in% excluded_self_report,
    excluded_low_performance = participant %in% excluded_low_performance,
    retained = !participant %in% excluded_participants
  )

Data_Participant_Exclusions <- Data_Participant_Status %>%
  filter(!retained) %>%
  transmute(
    participant,
    exclusion_reason = if_else(
      excluded_self_report,
      "Self-reported distraction or aid use",
      "Low processing-task performance"
    )
  )

Summary_Participant_Exclusion <- Data_Participant_Status %>%
  summarise(
    recruited = n(),
    self_report = sum(excluded_self_report),
    low_perf = sum(excluded_low_performance),
    retained = sum(retained)
  )

Summary_Participant_Exclusion

```

## 2.3 Create analysis-ready datasets

### 2.3.1 Processing-task trials

```{r}

# Processing task data from the Single-task phase
Data_Processing_ST <- Raw_data %>%
  filter(screenID == "processing", !participant %in% excluded_participants) %>%
  mutate(
    RT = rt / 1000,
    trialID = as.numeric(str_remove(trialID, "P"))
  ) %>%
  select(
    participant, blockID, trialID, condition, phase,
    correctResp, acc, RT
  )

# Processing task data from the Complex-span phase
Data_Processing_CS <- Raw_data %>%
  filter(screenID == "memory-resp", !participant %in% excluded_participants) %>%
  mutate(
    target = ifelse(leftImage == "image26", rightImage, leftImage),
    RT = rt / 1000,
    trialID = as.numeric(trialID)
  ) %>%
  select(
    participant, blockID, trialID, condition, phase,
    correctResp, target, acc, RT
  )

Data_Processing <- bind_rows(
  Data_Processing_ST,
  Data_Processing_CS
) %>%
  arrange(participant, blockID, trialID, condition, phase, correctResp) %>%
  filter(
    trialID > max(trialID, na.rm = TRUE) - 15,
    .by = c(participant, phase)
  ) %>%
  filter(condition != "A") %>%
  mutate(
    RT = clean_rt(
      RT,
      min_cutoff = 0.2,
      sd_cutoff = 3,
      na_rm = TRUE
    ),
    .by = c(participant, phase)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    stepID = row_number(),
    .by = c(participant, phase, blockID, trialID)
  ) %>%
  select(participant, phase, blockID, trialID, stepID, condition, acc, RT)

# Save the processed data
write_rds(Data_Processing, str_glue("./data/processed/Data_{task}_Processing.rds"))

```

### 2.3.2 Memory-task retrieval trials

```{r}
Data_Ret <- Raw_data %>%
  filter(
    screenID == "retrieval",
    !participant %in% excluded_participants
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    step = row_number(),
    .by = c(participant, blockID, trialID)
  ) %>%
  select(
    participant, blockID, trialID, condition,
    step, target, distractor, response
  ) %>%
  mutate(trialID = as.numeric(trialID)) %>%
  left_join(
    Data_Processing_CS %>%
      select(participant, blockID, trialID, target, acc, RT) %>%
      rename(processing_acc = acc, processing_RT = RT),
    by = c("participant", "blockID", "trialID", "target")
  ) %>%
  score_retrieval_response(
    target_col = "target",
    distractor_col = "distractor",
    response_col = "response",
    .by = c("participant", "blockID", "trialID", "condition")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    order = ifelse(condition == first(condition), 0, 1),
    .by = participant
  )

# Save the processed data
write_rds(Data_Ret, str_glue("./data/processed/Data_{task}_Ret.rds"))

```

### 2.3.3 Cognitive-load summary

```{r}

Data_Trial_Accuracy <- Data_Ret %>%
  summarise(
    acc = mean(Correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    correct = sum(Correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    nRet = sum(!is.na(Correct)),
    .by = c(participant, condition)
  )

Data_Trial_Load <- Data_Processing %>%
  filter(phase == "ST") %>%
  summarise(
    load = mean(RT, na.rm = TRUE) / 2.5,
    .by = c(participant, condition)
  )

Data_Load <- Data_Trial_Accuracy %>%
  left_join(Data_Trial_Load, by = c("participant", "condition")) %>%
  filter(condition != "A", !is.na(load))

# Save the processed data
write_rds(Data_Load, str_glue("./data/processed/Data_{task}_load.rds"))
```


# 3 Data visualization

## 3.1 Processing-task step effects

### 3.1.1 Reaction time by step

```{r}

Plot_Processing_Step_RT <- Data_Processing %>%
  filter(acc == 1, !is.na(RT)) %>%
  agg_plot(y = RT, within = c(condition, phase, stepID), group = participant) %>%
  mutate(
    phase = label_phase(phase),
    condition = label_condition(condition)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = stepID, y = mean, group = phase, fill = phase)) +

    aes(ymin = mean - ci, ymax = mean + ci),

  labs(
    y = "Reaction Time (s)",
    x = "Step",
    fill = "Phase",
    title = "Reaction Time",
    tag = "a"
  )

```

# 4 Bayesian analysis

Model-fitting chunks below submit background tasks through `taskr`. Run them
interactively, wait for each task to finish, and then run the corresponding
prior, Bayes-factor, and posterior chunks.

## 4.1 Processing-task models

### 4.1.1 Reaction-time model

#### Prepare reaction-time model data

Model variables `Judge` and `Dist` use additive component coding, with `B` (R)
as the baseline.

```{r}
mData_Processing_RT <- Data_Processing %>%
  filter(acc == 1, !is.na(RT)) %>%
  mutate(
    Judge = ifelse(condition == "B", 0, 1),
    Dist = ifelse(condition == "D", 1, 0),
    phase = ifelse(phase == "ST", -0.5, 0.5),
    step = stepID - mean(stepID)
  ) %>%
  select(participant, Judge, Dist, phase, step, RT)

Formula_Processing_RT <- bf(
  RT ~ b0 + bj * Judge + bd * Dist,
  b0 ~ 1 + phase * step + (1 + phase * step | participant),
  bj ~ 1 + phase * step + (1 + phase * step | participant),
  bd ~ 1 + phase * step + (1 + phase * step | participant),
  nl = TRUE
)

Priors_Processing_RT <- c(
  prior(normal(-0.4, 0.5), class = "b", nlpar = "b0", coef = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.2), class = "b", nlpar = "b0"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.2), class = "b", nlpar = "bj"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.2), class = "b", nlpar = "bd"),

  prior(student_t(3, 0, 0.5), class = "sd", nlpar = "b0", lb = 0),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 0.5), class = "sd", nlpar = "bj", lb = 0),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 0.5), class = "sd", nlpar = "bd", lb = 0)
)
```

#### Fit reaction-time model

```{r}
taskr::submit_task(
  fun = brms::brm,
  args = list(
    formula = Formula_Processing_RT,
    data = mData_Processing_RT,
    family = lognormal(),
    prior = Priors_Processing_RT,
    chains = 8,
    iter = 10000,
    warmup = 2500,
    cores = 8,
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 15),
    save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
    backend = "cmdstanr",
    file = str_glue("{model_path}Model_{task}_Processing_RT"),
    file_refit = "on_change"
  ),
  label = str_glue("Model_{task}_Processing_RT"),
  output = "none"
)

```

#### Fit reaction-time prior model

```{r}

# Run this block after the reaction-time model task has completed.
Model_Processing_RT <- read_rds(
  str_glue("{model_path}Model_{task}_Processing_RT.rds")
)

taskr::submit_task(
  fun = unupdate,
  args = list(model = Model_Processing_RT),
  label = str_glue("Prior_{task}_Processing_RT"),
  output = "all"
)

Model_Prior_Processing_RT <- taskr::get_task_result(
  max(taskr::get_task_overview(
    label = str_glue("Prior_{task}_Processing_RT")
  )$id)
)
```

#### Compute reaction-time Bayes factors
```{r}
BF_Processing_RT <- model_parameter_bf_table(
  Model_Processing_RT,
  prior = Model_Prior_Processing_RT,
  task = task,
  model_label = "Processing_RT"
) %>%
  separate_wider_delim(parameter, "_", names = c(NA, "component", "effect"), too_few = "align_start", cols_remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(effect = str_replace_all(effect, ":", "_"))

BF_Processing_RT
```


### 4.1.2 Accuracy model

#### Prepare accuracy model data

```{r}
mData_Processing_Accuracy <- Data_Processing %>%
  mutate(
    Judge = ifelse(condition == "B", 0, 1),
    Dist = ifelse(condition == "D", 1, 0),
    phase = ifelse(phase == "ST", -0.5, 0.5),
    step = stepID - mean(stepID)
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    score = sum(acc),
    nRet = n(),
    .by = c(participant, Judge, Dist, phase, step)
  )

Formula_Processing_Accuracy <- bf(
  score | trials(nRet) ~ b0 + bj * Judge + bd * Dist,
  b0 ~ 1 + phase * step + (1 + phase * step | participant),
  bj ~ 1 + phase * step + (1 + phase * step | participant),
  bd ~ 1 + phase * step + (1 + phase * step | participant),
  nl = TRUE
)

Priors_Processing_Accuracy <- c(
  # Accuracy is on the logit scale, so the baseline prior is wider than RT.
  prior(logistic(0, 0.75), class = "b", nlpar = "b0", coef = "Intercept"),
  prior(logistic(0, 0.25), class = "b", nlpar = "b0"),
  prior(logistic(0, 0.25), class = "b", nlpar = "bj"),
  prior(logistic(0, 0.25), class = "b", nlpar = "bd"),

  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sd", nlpar = "b0", lb = 0),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sd", nlpar = "bj", lb = 0),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sd", nlpar = "bd", lb = 0)
)
```

#### Fit accuracy model

```{r}
taskr::submit_task(
  fun = brms::brm,
  args = list(
    formula = Formula_Processing_Accuracy,
    data = mData_Processing_Accuracy,
    family = binomial(),
    prior = Priors_Processing_Accuracy,
    chains = 8,
    iter = 10000,
    warmup = 2500,
    cores = 8,
    backend = "cmdstanr",
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 15),
    save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
    file = str_glue("{model_path}Model_{task}_Processing_Correct"),
    file_refit = "on_change"
  ),
  label = str_glue("Model_{task}_Processing_Correct"),
  output = "none"
)

```

#### Fit accuracy prior model

```{r}

# Run this block after the accuracy model task has completed.
Model_Processing_Accuracy <- read_rds(
  str_glue("{model_path}Model_{task}_Processing_Correct.rds")
)

taskr::submit_task(
  fun = unupdate,
  args = list(model = Model_Processing_Accuracy),
  label = str_glue("Prior_{task}_Processing_Correct"),
  output = "all"
)

Model_Prior_Processing_Accuracy <- taskr::get_task_result(
  max(taskr::get_task_overview(
    label = str_glue("Prior_{task}_Processing_Correct")
  )$id)
)

```

#### Compute accuracy Bayes factors
```{r}
BF_Processing_Accuracy <- model_parameter_bf_table(
  Model_Processing_Accuracy,
  prior = Model_Prior_Processing_Accuracy,
  task = task,
  model_label = "Processing_Correct"
) %>%
  separate_wider_delim(parameter, "_", names = c(NA, "component", "effect"), too_few = "align_start", cols_remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(effect = str_replace_all(effect, ":", "_"))

BF_Processing_Accuracy

```

### 4.1.3 Combine and save Bayes factors

```{r}
BF_Processing <- bind_rows(BF_Processing_RT, BF_Processing_Accuracy)
write_csv(BF_Processing, str_glue("{stats_path}BF_{task}_processing.csv"))
```

### 4.1.4 Posterior distributions

#### Load fitted processing models

```{r}
Model_Processing_RT <- read_rds(
  str_glue("{model_path}Model_{task}_Processing_RT.rds")
)

Model_Processing_Accuracy <- read_rds(
  str_glue("{model_path}Model_{task}_Processing_Correct.rds")
)
```

#### Extract fixed-effect posterior draws

```{r}
processing_component_labels <- c(
  b0 = "Baseline",
  bj = "Size Judgment",
  bd = "Distractor Encoding"
)

processing_effect_labels <- c(
  Intercept = "Component (Intercept)",
  phase = "Phase",
  step = "Step",
  "phase:step" = "Memory Load (Phase × Step)"
)

Data_Processing_Posterior <- list(
  "Reaction Time" = Model_Processing_RT,
  "Accuracy" = Model_Processing_Accuracy
) %>%
  map(
    ~ tidybayes::gather_draws(
      .x,
      `^b_(b0|bj|bd)_.*`,
      regex = TRUE,
      draw_indices = ".draw"
    )
  ) %>%
  list_rbind(names_to = "outcome") %>%
  extract(
    .variable,
    into = c("component_code", "effect_code"),
    regex = "^b_([^_]+)_(.+)$"
  ) %>%
  rename(effect_size = .value) %>%
  mutate(
    outcome = factor(outcome, levels = c("Reaction Time", "Accuracy")),
    component = factor(
      recode(component_code, !!!processing_component_labels),
      levels = rev(unname(processing_component_labels))
    ),
    component_y = as.numeric(component) / 2,
    effect = factor(
      recode(effect_code, !!!processing_effect_labels),
      levels = unname(processing_effect_labels)
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!(effect == "Component (Intercept)" & component == "Baseline"))
```

#### Plot and save posterior distributions

```{r}
processing_component_colors <- c(
  "Baseline" = "#C7D0D8",
  "Size Judgment" = "#A9C4E2",
  "Distractor Encoding" = "#F1C79A"
)

Plot_Processing_Posterior <- Data_Processing_Posterior %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = effect_size, y = component_y, fill = component)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = Data_Processing_Posterior %>%
      filter(effect == "Memory Load (Phase × Step)") %>%
      distinct(outcome, effect),
    xmin = -Inf,
    xmax = Inf,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "#FFFDF7",
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey45") +
  stat_slab(
    normalize = "groups",
    scale = 0.72,
    height = 0.38,
    alpha = 0.85,
    slab_color = NA
  ) +
  stat_pointinterval(
    .width = 0.95,
    point_interval = median_qi,
    point_color = "grey25",
    interval_color = "grey55",
    interval_size_range = c(0.25, 0.55),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  ggh4x::facet_grid2(
    outcome ~ effect,
    scales = "free_x",
    independent = "x",
    switch = "y"
  ) +
  ggh4x::force_panelsizes(
    cols = c(1, 1, 0.85, 1.25)
  ) +
  ggh4x::facetted_pos_scales(
    x = list(
      outcome == "Reaction Time" & effect == "Step" ~ scale_x_continuous(
        limits = c(-0.052, 0.048),
        breaks = c(-0.04, -0.02, 0.00, 0.02, 0.04),
        labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.01, style_negative = "minus")
      ),
      outcome == "Reaction Time" & effect == "Memory Load (Phase × Step)" ~ scale_x_continuous(
        limits = c(-0.068, 0.052),
        breaks = c(-0.06, -0.04, -0.02, 0.00, 0.02, 0.04),
        labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.01, style_negative = "minus")
      ),
      outcome == "Accuracy" & effect == "Step" ~ scale_x_continuous(
        limits = c(-0.6, 0.6),
        breaks = c(-0.50, -0.25, 0.00, 0.25, 0.50),
        labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.01, style_negative = "minus")
      ),
      outcome == "Accuracy" & effect == "Memory Load (Phase × Step)" ~ scale_x_continuous(
        limits = c(-0.68, 0.95),
        breaks = c(-0.60, -0.3, 0.00, 0.3, 0.60, 0.9),
        labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.01, style_negative = "minus")
      )
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = processing_component_colors,
    breaks = names(processing_component_colors)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = NULL,
    expand = expansion(mult = 0)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.4, 1.95)) +
  labs(
    x = "Parameter Estimate",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Component"
  ) +
  theme_posterior()

# Plot_Processing_Posterior

ggsave(
  path = figure_path,
  filename = str_glue("Plot_{task}_processing_posterior.png"),
  plot = Plot_Processing_Posterior,
  width = 12,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

```

## 4.2 Memory-task model

### 4.2.1 Prepare memory model data

The existing coefficient names are retained so the fitted memory model remains
compatible with its saved results.

```{r}

mData_Memory_Accuracy <- Data_Ret %>%
  select(participant, condition, Correct) %>%
  summarise(
    Resp = sum(Correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    nResp = sum(!is.na(Correct)),
    .by = c(participant, condition)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    simple = ifelse(condition != "A", 1, 0),
    judge = ifelse(condition %in% c("C", "D"), 1, 0),
    distractor = ifelse(condition == "D", 1, 0)
  )
```

### 4.2.2 Fit memory model

```{r}

taskr::submit_task(
  fun = brms::brm,
  args = list(
    data = mData_Memory_Accuracy,
    formula = Resp | trials(nResp) ~ 1 + simple + judge + distractor +
      (1 + simple + judge + distractor | participant),
    family = binomial(),
    prior = c(
      prior(logistic(0, 0.75), class = "Intercept"),
      prior(logistic(0, 0.25), class = "b"),
      prior(student_t(3, 0, 2), class = "sd", lb = 0)
    ),
    chains = 8,
    iter = 10000,
    warmup = 2500,
    cores = 8,
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 15),
    save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
    sample_prior = "yes",
    backend = "cmdstanr",
    file = str_glue("{model_path}Model_{task}_Memory_Correct"),
    file_refit = "on_change"
  ),
  label = str_glue("Model_{task}_Memory_Correct"),
  output = "none"
)
```

### 4.2.3 Compute memory Bayes factors

```{r}
# Run this block after the memory model task has completed.
Model_Memory_Accuracy <- read_rds(
  str_glue("{model_path}Model_{task}_Memory_Correct.rds")
)

BF_Memory_Accuracy <- model_parameter_bf_table(
  Model_Memory_Accuracy,
  task = task,
  model_label = "Memory_Correct"
)
write_csv(BF_Memory_Accuracy, str_glue("{stats_path}BF_{task}_memory.csv"))

BF_Memory_Accuracy
```
